author: Inside Edition
description: It was a terrifying moment caught on camera. The driver of a public minibus got sleepy and started to nod off. In no time, the bus veered off course and hit a wall, coming to a halt. The man riding shotgun appeared to have struck his head during the impact. Other passengers screamed in terror or pain. Seven people were injured, and were taken to hospitals. The accident, captured on a dashcam from within the bus, happened in southern Turkey's Adana province.
title: Driver Falls Asleep, Crashes Bus Into Police Station
